tools.name: search_wiki
tools.description: Search the published wiki by English name or keyword. Set type to Action or Income route to search that calculator’s published presets. For a Quest step, pass its questId and section ID to get_wiki_entry as a Quest.

tools.name: get_wiki_entry
tools.description: Read the published guide for a type and ID from search_wiki. Returns an outline and paginated text, table rows and source links. Pass a section ID from the outline for a specific topic, such as drops or recipes. Action and Income route return their published calculator presets.

tools.name: calculate_xp
tools.description: Plan actions, time, XP and missing materials for a target level, remaining XP, or a batch of items. Use an Action ID from search_wiki or supply your measured action values. Stock defaults to zero. Results use base rates unless you supply measured values.

tools.name: calculate_drop
tools.description: Calculate the chance of at least one drop, expected items and GP from independent kills. Use an enemy and item ID for site presets or provide manual values. Chance inputs and numeric probability results are fractions from 0 to 1.

tools.name: calculate_gp
tools.description: Calculate net GP, GP per hour and time to a GP goal from a website Income route ID or a measured run. Input fields override preset values. Active time is required for a manual run.

tools.name: check_idle_combat
tools.description: Check whether a specified hit leaves the player alive before Auto Eat. Supply the largest HP loss after protection, including concurrent effects before the next check. Optionally estimate food from a measured test fight.

tools.name: read_player_save
tools.description: Read only the player snapshot JSON that the player explicitly shared from My character. Use itemIds to inspect selected bank counts, or compare a published recipe against the shared skill XP and bank. Never ask for a raw save string or a file path.
